title: 31 Seabed Mining Contracts Triggered A Global Backlash
hook: Battery metals beneath the ocean are creating a political fight.
closing: The outcome could reshape battery supplies and determine how much ocean floor gets disturbed.
question: Should seabed mining proceed?

segments.say: Deep-sea exploration contracts reached 31. The seabed metal rush is no longer theoretical.
Seabed nodules contain 44 million tonnes of cobalt. That potential battery supply explains the rush.
37 countries now support a seabed mining pause or ban. Political resistance is catching up.
